title: Activation & Onboarding Funnel Optimization

purpose_limitation.description: Candidate data is processed only for recommendation and activation measurement.

data_minimization.description: Only fields required for ranking and experiment measurement are retained.

protected_attribute_exclusion.description: Sensitive/protected attributes are excluded from the recommendation feature schema.

deletion_ready_identifier.description: candidate_id is retained as the stable deletion and audit reference.

consent_notice_required_for_live_capture.description: Live user capture must use an appropriate notice and lawful processing basis before production use.

limitations: Evaluation uses a local held-out dataset, not production traffic.
Live experiment events are locally captured demonstration evidence.
Production A/B activation lift has not been measured.
Production-scale statistical significance has not been established.
Fairness group metrics are not computed because valid group labels and sufficient sample size are unavailable.
